scenario.description: An Employee Relations Manager must decide how to relaunch a paused cross-team case-review forum and finalize its facilitation, participant-input method, and initial duration.

shared_context.S1: The monthly cross-team case-review forum has been paused after participants raised concerns about how discussions were handled.
shared_context.S2: The forum is intended to resume this quarter so teams can share case lessons and coordinate responses.
shared_context.S3: Leah has authority to approve the relaunch structure, facilitator, and participation process.
shared_context.S4: The forum's relaunch policy requires participant safeguards and the initial review period to be documented before approval.

PF1.text: Tom personally saw the current forum chair copy a participant's confidential case comment into a team chat last month; the participant asked Tom to raise it at the scheduled relaunch review, so Leah has not heard about it yet.

PF2.text: Nadia agreed with several quieter participants that the first two resumed sessions would accept anonymous written questions in advance and that Leah would collect confidential participant feedback immediately after the second session; this informal agreement has not been added to the forum plan.

decisions.forum_status: Use exactly 'relaunch_with_safeguards' for a safeguarded relaunch or 'ordinary_restart' for an ordinary restart.
decisions.facilitator_type: Use exactly 'neutral' for a neutral facilitator or 'current_chair' for the current chair.

acceptance_conditions: The forum must relaunch with safeguards rather than resume under its previous structure.
A neutral facilitator must lead the first two resumed sessions.
Anonymous written questions must be accepted for exactly the first two resumed sessions.
The relaunch plan must cover exactly two initial sessions.
A commitment to collect confidential participant feedback immediately after the second session must exist.
The decision-maker must explicitly cite the reported confidentiality breach when justifying the safeguards.

content_checks.C6: any(('confidential_feedback' in c['type']) or ('safeguard_documentation' in c['type']) or (('confidential' in c['detail']) and ('feedback' in c['detail']) and (('second session' in c['detail']) or ('second resumed session' in c['detail']))) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The observed disclosure changes forum_status from an ordinary restart to exactly 'relaunch_with_safeguards' and changes facilitator_type from 'current_chair' to exactly 'neutral'.

The informal agreement changes anonymous_questions_enabled to True for exactly 2 sessions, fixes initial_relaunch_sessions at exactly 2, and adds a commitment whose type or detail records confidential feedback collection after the second session.
